get.summary: Get up to 500 raw passings for a transponder in an inclusive UTC window
get.description: Requires transponderId (nonempty UUID), from and to (ISO 8601 UTC timestamps with Z or +00:00). The inclusive window may be zero through seven days. Unknown, empty, malformed and duplicate query parameters return 400. Ordered by Time, then Id; Truncated indicates additional matches. Responses are no-store.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Required inclusive UTC instant (Z or +00:00); window at most seven days.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Required inclusive UTC instant (Z or +00:00); window at most seven days.

post.summary: Re-submit matching rejected passings; rows that now record, duplicate or conflict are deleted
